## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, including failure and rollback cases where relevant
- [ ] OpenAPI and documentation updated (English first)
- [ ] No real domains, IP addresses, node names, tokens, keys or personal data (`python scripts/check-hygiene.py` passes)
- [ ] For plugins: permissions declared in the manifest, no install scripts
